declared_proposition: For every prime q>5, let U_q=(2^(q-1)-1)/q, V_q=(3^(q-1)-1)/q, and let P_q be the TICKET-246 polynomial. Define W_q(a,b)=((a^(q-1)-b^(q-1))/q) mod q. Then exactly P_q(U_q,V_q)=W_q(32,27) mod q and U_q-V_q=W_q(2,3) mod q. Consequently the actual quotient pair violates first-level valuation domination precisely at primes in the set {W_q(32,27)=0} minus {W_q(2,3)=0}. These are separated generalized-Wieferich primes.
mathematical_argument: The exact identities 32^(q-1)-27^(q-1)=qP_q(U_q,V_q) and 2^(q-1)-3^(q-1)=q(U_q-V_q) were proved in TICKET-246. Divide by q and reduce modulo q. Thus v_q(P_q)>0 while v_q(U_q-V_q)=0 if and only if q^2 divides the first base difference but not the second. This is an exact arithmetic reduction, not an inference from the finite scan.

finite_computation_boundary: Exact modular arithmetic checks all 78,495 primes q<= 1,000,000; zero finite hits do not prove global absence.
logical_limit: The actual bad-prime set is now exact, but neither its emptiness nor nonemptiness is proved, and even settling that valuation route would not control all Collatz trajectories.

route_decision.discard: treating a finite absence of separated generalized-Wieferich primes as an all-prime arithmetic exclusion
parked: all-prime exclusion of separated generalized-Wieferich primes without a structural theorem
route_decision.retain: an exact construction or obstruction for separated generalized-Wieferich primes comparing 32/27 with 2/3

claim_boundary: No Collatz proof, divergent orbit, or cycle; one exact reduction of the actual first-level branch obstruction to a separated generalized-Wieferich set.
